maria: Evening handover — swapping with @nate at 19:30 UTC. Quick rundown of what changed and what to watch:
- Canary (eu) started showing ~2-3% increased 5xxs on long sequences (>1024 tokens) since the 03:40 model roll. Watching error rate and latency tail.
- We adjusted KV eviction threshold from 0.90 -> 0.95 to reduce memory pressure for large-context jobs. This may increase evictions; please monitor.
- Scheduled infra maintenance: kernel/container runtime patch at 02:00 UTC (expected 3–7m of elevated latencies while nodes recycle).
- Planned dedicated-west-1 capacity drain for perf experiment tonight 23:45 UTC — traffic will spill to hosted fallback. Expect throughput drop on batch-heavy routes.
- PRs needing eyes: PR-317 (canary logging tweaks), PR-329 (kv eviction telemetry), PR-342 (dedicated pool rollout config). If you can grab one please comment.
Action items: check canary error graphs, validate kv eviction rate after threshold change, ping reviewers on the PRs, and keep an eye on the dedicated pool drain.

maria: Quick ops commands if you need them:
```
kubectl logs -n prod -l app=canary --tail=200 | grep ERROR
# check live eviction rate from metrics: query name: redwood_kv_evictions_total / redwood_requests_total by (job)
```

chen: Do we have a fallback plan if evictions spike >1% for 10m?

maria: Good call — plan is to revert threshold to 0.88 and pause the dedicated drain. I'll make the revert if evictions >1% sustained for 5m (we're being slightly aggressive tonight). Runbook: https://wiki.redwood/inference/kv-evictions-runbook

nate: I can take the 19:30 swap and own canary monitoring, will alert if we hit the 1% cutoff. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Scheduled maintenance alert: infra-deploy-job-892 queued for 02:00 UTC — nodes tagged for drain starting 01:50 UTC.

lucy: Heads up I'm OOO tomorrow morning until ~12:00 UTC. I can review PR-342 after 12:30 if still open.

joel: I'll pick up PR-317 tonight, aim to have review in by 21:00 UTC.

maria: Awesome — assigning PR-317 -> @joel, PR-329 -> @chen if you have cycles, PR-342 -> @lucy (or ping @joel if urgent).

maria: Observability links: canary error graph: https://dashboards.redwood/canary/errors ; kv eviction dashboard: https://dashboards.redwood/kv/evictions

maria: Final notes: if you see latency spikes during the kernel patch, don't escalate unless >2x p99 or sustained >10m. Otherwise add notes to the maintenance ticket: INF-4521. Thanks and enjoy the evening :wave:
